summary: # Introduction to New Features in Marvelous Designer 2025.1 - AI Pose Generator (Beta) ## Overview of the AI Pose Generator In this video, we explore how to create a virtual model using the AI Pose Generator feature in Marvelous Designer 2025.1. This tool allows users to easily generate poses by utilizing keywords or reference pictures. ## Creating a Virtual Model Pose To begin, follow these steps: 1. **Access the AI Pose Generator:** - Click on the virtual model option located in the top menu. 2. **Input Keywords or Upload Reference Pictures:** - You can either enter keywords to generate a reference picture or upload a reference image directly. - **Select Gender:** Ensure to select the appropriate gender for your virtual model. 3. **Utilizing Keyword Suggestions:** - Click on the keyword suggestion feature to assist in choosing the right keywords. - After selecting your keywords, click on the "Keep Keywords" button. This action retains the existing results as much as possible while allowing for updates to the keywords. ## Generating Poses It’s important to note the following when generating poses: - Even if the same keywords are used, the AI will recreate the pose each time. - Modifying or adding keywords may lead to different results than previously generated. ### Random Keywords You can also click on random keywords to receive a variety of suggestions. However, for more effective results, it’s recommended to enter precise descriptive words rather than lengthy sentences. 1. **Enter Keywords:** - After entering your keywords, click on the "Create" button to generate the virtual model pose based on your specifications. - **Note:** The creation process may take additional time during periods of high user activity. ## Working with Reference Pictures To enhance the quality of your AI-generated poses, follow these guidelines: 1. **Switching Card Types:** - Transition from the Keyword Select Card to the Picture Select Card. The background image will serve as your reference picture. 2. **Uploading Reference Images:** - Click on the upload button to add an image. It is highly recommended to use full-body images from head to toe to ensure high-quality AI posture generation. 3. **Saving Your Creation:** - After generating the pose, click on the "Save" button to save the posture as a PAUSE file. This posture can now be applied to the selected virtual model. ## Adjusting the Pose Once you have created a posture, you can enable the display of virtual model joints to make further adjustments. Additionally, you can utilize shortcut keys for a more efficient workflow. --- That’s all for this video. Thank you for watching, and I look forward to seeing you in the next video!
